items.brief: Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B sterling fund on XRP Ledger
items.why: Second Aviva fund with tokenized shares; part of effort to bring more tokenized funds to XRP Ledger.

items.brief: Securitize's tokenized stock value halves as Circle widens lead
items.why: Shows shifting market share among tokenized equity issuers in a $3.3B tokenized equities market.

items.brief: Why McDonald's, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
items.why: Issuer pushback on tokenized securities venue reflects caution, not rejection of tokenization.
